review_text: This is a very nice bag but the charger did not work. Since I didn’t used it immediately after I purchased it; I was not aware of the charger not working until I traveled. By then it was too late to return it. My advice is to test the charger as soon as you receive the bag!
I am going to buy more.
Much smaller than anticipated. No way to carry books and laptop.
This product was not what I was looking for. Thought it was. It was to thin and to me cheaply made.

I bought mine for around 140 ducks on sale. The darn thing now has broken zippers after three years because the metal zippers used is fragile, and very thin (~0.5 mm). Would recommend Everki over this.. the warranty only lasts 1 year from TrailPack..
Bought the all black version backpack, it feels fairly sturdy and got it for a great price.
Everything is awesome about it, except no side pockets for water bottle.

This bag not only secures a 17" laptop but it has so many other pockets that are suitable for carrying anything else you need. When it's on your back it is comfortable to wear for extended periods of time.

I loved this pack at first. Then realized the earbud port is not functional, as the velcro patch on the opposite side of the flap prevents access. No ez link to contact seller so I unfortunately must post here... Note: replacement has same flaw as well...I have reached out to seller...want this bag to work for me!
Looks better in the photos. It looks kind of smushed and flat in person.
What a lifesaver! Traveling back-n-forth to NY has been a breeze with this backpack. Great all-around!
The bag is just what my son wanted. Great size and not to being for him to carry

I bought this for my wife in late February and as of yesterday, the whole thing was falling apart. The zippers broke and the bag was tearing by the seams near the zipper line. She had to tape it together until she got home. Don't buy this bag. It's not worth the money.
Incredible value for the money, very well made and thought out!
Bulky and big and not that much room on the inside. It’s already heavy without anything it it too.
I use this as a work bag. Works great. Sturdy, light weight and holds plenty of items!

The backpack purse is made out of high quality materials. It also looks great. The drawback, and why I gave it a 4 instead of a 5, is the backpack is not as thick as the video makes it appear. That being said, even though the space seems to fit a lot, when you zip the front pocket and the middle pocket is full and clasped, it appears to look strained and over capacity. Adding just another half inch to inch would have made all the difference.

Straps are very comfortable, it looks great and fits all my stuff. Just big enough to occasionally cram my gym gear into too. (This was a gift so her words, not mine… she hated my first gift - a utilitarian Northface backpack).
Absolutely love this backpack!! It is sleek considering the space available, comfortable, and really just perfect. I use mine daily and may buy another for travel. Thanks!
A nice bag but too heavy and overpriced.
Great size for young kid gamer to carry variety of electronics,cords,chargers etc. Like the theft deterrant lock
used for carry on travel bag.. durability is great but the large front zippered area would be better accessible with double zippered opening like the top zipper..
Flimsy. I bought this for my son for second grade. Just putting his normal sized lunchbox was too much for the zipper. Wish I could give it zerro stars.
Great idea, but you get what you pay for. They lose connection constantly and only work if you’re within so many feet of the item. Not exactly conducive for finding lost things
Garbage product. Zipper is cheap and sticks. Straps are not ergonomic and entire product is cheaply made.
It’s cute but not too roomy on the inside, I’m able to fit what I need so it’s not too bad but I don’t see myself using it to travel, could be a spennanight bag for sure though

This was almost a very nice bag. It fits fairly well under most airline seats, sticking out a few inches. There are too many zippered compartments - and one of the zippers on mine was broken. It zipped-up shut and then just popped-open. The manufacturer cannot be reached and the only option was to get a refund. I didn't want to risk getting another bag with a broken zipper so I moved up to a TrailPack under seat bag.
This bag is nice, but the zipper is flimsy and the front pocket wasn’t sewn correctly. Will not stand up by itself like some other backpacks made the same way
Nice, well constructed backpack with plenty of room. Just right for me.

The material is ok. I notice after a few days there was some wear on the zipper part. There were some loose strings comping from thw zipper area, and it only contained my laptop. It does have lots od cpmpartments though. Could work for travel.

I needed a new laptop bag and I liked the color of this one so I thought I'd give it a try. The gold zippers against the olive green look really nice. This bag has endless pockets! There is so much storage inside and out, but yet still looks sleek and not bulky. The zippers all seem to work nicely. I haven't used it in the rain so I don't know if it is weatherproof, but it seems to be. The handle on the top of the bag seems to be reinforced so I don't think that will be breaking anytime soon.
Nice bag but a little smaller than what i needed. Returned it. Purchased another bag about the same dimensions but hold more -- i guess just the way it is designed.
Looks great and looks durable. Have not tested it, but shall later this month in Fla and then Europe in April....
This is for an iPhone 4. If you have an old iphone from 2010, then it’s going to work. They need t update it to the iPhone XR type connector and not the wide pin kind.
Loved this when it came out of the box. Heavy canvas, feels sturdy, looks great. Lots of compliments on the style. The rivet snaps fell apart pretty fast and it's useless.
Nice looking product—too bad it showed up with opened packages of food inside. Check your merchandise if you are going to resell something that someone has returned.

While this is pretty sturdy, the ability to get into the bag easily is hampered by way in which the eye holes slip over the buttons, holding the bag closed. The leather eventually will rip and then there is no way to secure the flap. I should have returned it, but was already on my trip. I'll stick with zippered bags in the future

Nice addition to my desk space to easily hang my headphones instead of just throwing them on the desk or anywhere else. Keeps them out of the way yet easily accessible. The only thing I wish is that they had better cord hanging holes... the holes don't really hold anything. It's nothing to wrap up the cord and hang it with the headphones but the built in function doesn't really work at all.. A good product to have.

My son who is not a rough handler with his things, managed to break the handles in the second week of school. Will not buy this product or anything else similar to it. It was not sturdy, it did not have a lot of books or anything heavy in it.
Very durable and easy to zip, lots of places to store things.

So I bought this because someone mentioned it fits their Omen 17 laptop. It fits yes, but it is super tight. I worry about the zipper. Other then that it seems pretty sturdy. (I'll make a update in 6 months just in case) The bag is really nice looking as well, so even if I did not have a laptop I will be using it as my main bag from now on.

I would give this bag five stars but the color is very off from the photo. The khaki color which is very tan in the photo is a much darker olive green tone khaki, one of my least favorite colors. I expected it to not be perfect but this color is way off. On the bright side it's big, comfy and otherwise attractive. The ugly brand patch is easily removed with a seam ripper.

If you carry a larger laptop, this bag is great. I like it for when I travel for work. I can fit my laptop and everything else I need to carry on to the plane. If it is just an overnight trip, I can fit everything into this one bag. Keeps my laptop nice and safe. Convenient pockets. Not in love with all the dangly bits and loops, but perhaps someone is using them. Since I get cold easily, I like that I can tuck my sweater through the cinchers for easy access without having to dig through my bag.
Very thin material, no pockets on the sides.
I love it. Very durable and spacious. You are able to carry many things.
does not really feel or look like it does in the picture, not a good every day bag.

Love this bag! More than enough room for the photo equipment I have (TrailPack A7, 3 lenses, tripod, misc accessories)! So many compartments for accessories, multiple access points for camera, multiple hanging spots for tripod. Fit great in overhead on recent trip to Kauai! Comfortable shoulder straps for longer hikes and nice padding on back.
This backpack is falling apart already I just received it in March! It’s a nice color but the quality is very poor. I’m disappointed.

It's a great looking backpack! I used it when I was traveling and it fit everything I needed it too and still had some room left over! Also a great price for what you're getting. I feel like a lot of people are bothered by the smell of plastic when things come in the mail. And this one smelled really strong of plastic so just let it air out for a couple days and that will eventually go away!
This backpack is a beautiful color and it holds up very well. It is a canvas backpack but it has a lot of storage room and you will be proud to wear it.
Not all synced. Not sure why. Kind of an expensive experiment if they don't all work. Still working in it
Love this backpack. I use it for school and store my laptop. I have used it whenever I go anywhere with my three kids, and I stuff it full. Comfy and do far has had nothing wrong with it.
very durable, i have about 35 pounds of textbooks every day with classes and it hasn't shown any signs of damage. The back is padded and comfortable. I'd highly recommend it to students
Few items like laptop, iPad and some tiny notebook can be accommodated. Not useful for anything else

Looks awesome and I use it a bunch, I specifically liked the wide open, but now it can be a pain to close if you don't have two hands. Also the wipe zipper is not like wipe pockets on other bags, it's really small.

The backpack is rather decent. I like the full-fleece lining laptop compartment. It's able to handle a 13" MacBook although it doesn't sit fully into the compartment. About an inch or so of the laptop will still be visible. Tried fitting a 15" MacBook, and it's just barely able to squeeze into the bag. The magnetic buttons still seem to work fine after months of usage. The leather straps however are starting to peel from the bottom edge.

I can’t comment on the durability or sturdiness. I’ve only been using this backpack for about a week. But I love it! I sure don’t have enough to fill all the pockets but. I use this for every day use. Somewhat as my purse. Plus also I can carry all my work papers.

Perfect for Disney World instead of a purse. The little pockets on the side are small and barely fit my water bottles..and Occasionally my bottle pops out. Lots of zippered compartments. Carried a package of ponchos for the family, 3 frozen water bottles, some snacks, 2 paperbacks, my meds, first aid kit and a couple fans that go around your neck. Lightweight. But not water proof - which is always handy. But overall a great deal.

The 17 inch is larger than I thought. Almost too large for work purposes to carry my iPad Pro and some other items. As a “personal item” for traveling I am here to tell you I filled it with a weekends worth of clothes etc and it fit just fine under the seat in front of me. Win!
My son loves this bag.
This backpack has so many pockets, it's awesome!! Very cute and not bulky.
Lau have this stuff is organize extra cords that you have

I give it an 8 out of 10 for durability it's not something you would want to throw tools in and take to a job site but it would be absolutely adequate for a student or cyclist, looks great, lightweight, good value for money

When I received my backpack it was sealed in plastic and put in a dust bag. I head something rattling inside the backpack when I began to open it and much to my shock, there were 2 vera bradley wallets (no tags so used), 2/3 bottle of hand sanitizer, and 2 used tubes of lip balms. The backpack appears to be in good shape but by virtue of the items inside the bag, it had been used.

I bought this to fit in my backpack for a trip to Europe. It fits perfectly. The finish scratches a bit, or I would have given it 5 stars. After 6 hours, the contents is cool, not cold, when you are out in the heat, but its what I needed. I would buy again.
It's a nice backpack. It just feels like plastic. My son is pretty rough on everything, so I don't see this lasting but for now it works and I love that it has a lot of pockets.
Weather resistant and light weight
Very nice bag for traveling. Perfect for the items needed close.

I get so many compliments on this bag. I love that the top has hard wire to keep it open to easily get to things with in it. The inside pockets and storage are great. The pocket on the back side fits an iphone easily.
Good quality, lot of pockets, sturdy material. Still waiting to see if it will stand upto toddler.
This bag is awesome! Great to use for a weekend getaway/ overnight - carry on bag for a flight. Wonderfully made!
Separate pocket for my kid's laptop. Small pockets inside for pens. The only small thing is it would be great if the pen pocket was zip or velcro so the pens didn't come out. Good quality.
I love this. So many pockets available!

I can communicate with it well, but I've had mine activated for 3 weeks and the battery is already at 40%. Also, it doesn't work with Alexa or Google Home. However, the price is great and it does work. Just keep an eye on that battery and use their app.
Easy to organize your items.
It’s canvas it’s doing to be destroyed by my kid. Luck life

AeroBuds STUDIO covers the ear AeroBuds SOLO sits on top of the ear both are excellent sound but I prefer Studio because they cover my ear instead of pressing down on my ear after a while with my AeroBuds SOLO pressing down it hurts my ear so I’m a AeroBuds studio fan NOW

4 stars because of return policy. There was No choice to drop off at UPS, only pick up or Amazon drop box. Our UPS store is 3 minutes away, yet we had to be home all day waiting for a pick up. Great sound, better than my AeroBuds 35s. Just didnt fit well at all. The cross piece is not padded enough and the phones slipped off easily. Of course, fit is individual. I switched to AeroBuds, they are much lighter and and the cross piece is much more padded and doesnt slip.
Good quality would buy again

This headphone set works amazingly well for me. I use it for listening to podcast or music while doing chores around the house, or playing video games it and works great. The earmuffs are a little small for me and can give my ears a bit of a headache after a while, and once the battery died after only 5 hours or so of listening to music. However it has worked perfectly for me and came at a great price.
#7 for work headphones and #1 for working properly!
Here’s the actual color of “Flourescence.” It’s that greenish white color one associates with glow-in-the-dark. I’m good with it.
Ordered a “like new” used item. Description said it had a 4.4mm headphone jack. The box was a relatively new, but item inside was nothing like described.

Terrible. Thus is Bang abd Olufsen. I paid what I expected...now inff F age two sets. The lack of buttons is a disaster. I have tried every ear piece size - ear buds still pop out of my ear when I move. I am still trying to make them work. Sad

My daughter likes them. The sound is good. They fit my 4 year-old's head, but not my 9 year old. They're square shaped with a cushion on top where it hits the head - I like the cushion but think the square shape makes the fit awkward. There are wires attached to both ear phone, which tend to tangle because my daughter moves around a lot. I prefer the wire coming out of only one side.

I loved this earphones they sounded real good but once I changed my phone I have not been able to connect without using their so called app. If u can figure out which app to download (their are 2 le AeroBuds sportsound app) u will be dealing with a trashing app, higest rating is 3.3 star. Unfortunately my return date expired may 22, so I'm stuck with a good product that I CANT USE!!! I wish I could get my money or an exchange. I'll even take my chance with an exchange.
Three pairs, none lasted more then a week, sweat kills them.
By far the best AeroBuds head phones I've owned. I've had every pair.
Too flimsy, don’t not close
Probably better headphones with this price tag, But love the looks honestly
The best I have found for my small ear canal . Sad I lost one but for sure ordered another pair in red this time..

For what I paid the sound quality and battery life were ok. Only used in my home so not packed for travel. I put it on after just 4 months and the plastic broke with normal wear. Nothing could be done about it since could apply pressure to glue it due to the curve of the headset. Duct taped it, but then the Blue Tooth stopped working. Another piece of worthless headset. Very tempted to give one star, but I should have known better on buying electronics on Amazon.

This is my second set of AeroBuds. I still own my original, and it has lasted a good five years but the ear pieces began to tear up so it was time for a new set. Great quality and sound . The only downfall to this type of headset vs earbuds is that it holds the heat in and makes me feel hotter during cardio.
It's cool ima buy another rn
Portable good sound no skips excellent player🙂
Extremely happy with the purchase. I wish I made it sooner. I use these all the time. Great quality and they look awesome. Very easy to use and hold a charge for about a week with moderate use.

They have an audio input, comes with audio cable, and that works with no battery or anything, so that's great because one day the battery will of course die. In the mean time, these are great Bluetooth headphones. I didn't realize they are on-ear which I usually hate, but these are pretty comfortable. I have a small head and they fit me fine, if you have a big head you'll probably find they're a little small.
Pretty comfortable for a music headset and especially for side sleepers. But it doesn’t cancel noise that well.

I love AeroBuds, but I hate knock offs. I ordered these while overseas and thought I was getting great sound quality. That is until I put them on... horrible sound. You know AeroBuds when you hear a difference and these look and felt like a fake. Never again will I order from this company due to the lack of genuine quality. I will say the company did respond back immediately and offer solutions to fix the problem. but spending 100 bucks and only getting back a little wasn't worth it.
I just received these today and they smelled so badly upon opening the package that I had to throw them away immediately.

I really like it’s sturdiness and the fitting. It’s really a life saver and I have attached it to my keychain. The only problem is that it’s a dirt magnet. The black cover looks dirty very soon after you start using it. Not too worried about it but you should know before buying.

These fit my 2.5 year old well and he could continue to wear them for years. They are not too tight which is great. They are a bit flimsy feeling, but have held up pretty well so far. I like that they have volume control so that he cannot hurt his ears. I definitely recommend these.

I have almost lost these I don't know how many times because they have such a horrible design and constantly fall off. They have horrible sound quality not even worth listening to music on them. They are just awful. I don't know if I got a bad set or what but I can hardly hear anything on them.
Returned due to not lasting as promised
These AeroBuds Bluetooth earphones were dead on arrival. I couldn’t pair them with my iPhone 12. I return them and got a credit back.
Over priced. Thought it was noise cancellating. It is far from that. Way over priced. It is not worth my time.

I really, really wanted to love these. They are extremely difficult to pair and they lose sound frequently. Also, not sure what the "blue lights" on the buds are....I've not seen them while attempting to pair them. Wish they'd marked Left/Right a bit more prominently as well. Will likely be sending them back.
Great headphones, don't like how hot they make my ears though. Overall great deal, much cheaper than purchasing in store.

These headphones sound as good as people say. They were pretty amazing. But the clamping force on these little headphones were so tight that they pretty much gave me a nasty headache within 10 minutes of use. It's a shame. Since there are so affordable and sound so good.
Works perfectly especially for a Teenager!
Seemed OK quality, but was VERY tall. Would not qualify for "personal item" on most airlines.
These were a gift for my boyfriend and he absolutely loves them. Uses them everyday at the gym.
Works amazing and outstanding sound and quality.

I love these headphones! I have a pretty tiny head so it is nice to have a better style of adjustment that makes them more comfortable for me. I also like that the whole headphones breaks down so you can compact them better if you are traveling with them. Sound quality is pretty good as well if you aren't a geek about audio.

I've had these for about two months and I'm very pleased that all of the headphones still work! Before each of my students received one, I shared the Dos and Don'ts for handling them safely. On the last day of school, students can take them home. I definitely plan on purchasing a new set for next year's class.
I recommend this item… it’s low priced…. Sound quality is OK for audio speaking… works pretty good with my phone AeroBuds Galaxy note 20…
Was a waste of money, two of them stop working after two months. After refund window time is up, they stop working. Was a waste of money, now I can’t return them and I have to purchase new ones.
Product is nice and affordable.

These headsets were great. I'm not big fan of touch controls instead of a button. Every thing worked for a while but today the right ear bud just decided to stop working. The app says it's 100% but will not turn on. The battery on each headset is a little short. I listen to books and they last about 2.5 to 3 hours a bud. Your sweat can pause what ever you listen to which may be annoying to some. Also which there was a way to power on and off the headset without the case

These hooked to my IPhone easily and have a good sound. They do NOT cancel out noise. Also, people can hear what you are listening to. I don’t know why I thought these would work has headphones. They are just speakers.

The sound quality is not that great and they're not very noise cancelling. Also, one huge issue, and the reason I'll never buy this brand again, is the huge, clunky, heavy, rectangular power button! It is so heavy any uncomfortable and pulls on that side's earbud to where it pops out of your ear. It's also hard to use these while lying down. I'm very disappointed!
Cute case buy it for a gift with AeroBuds.

My tv has Bluetooth so now I can watch tv while my husband sleeps. I also fall asleep listening to audiobooks while I drift off to sleep. Fits great easy to sleep with it on, I’m a side sleeper the speakers are soft so they don’t bother you. Easy to charge and you can also take it all apart to wash it. I will be buying more to give as gifts.
The sound quality is standard, but don't know much about noise cancellation. The battery life could be longer instead of just 6 hours.
really good sound, connects seamlessly, really light and comfortable. for the daily commuter, this is king

Really great quality earphone tips. Bought off of the recommendation of a review for headphones I was looking at ( SoundMAGIC E10 Noise Isolating In-Ear Earphones). Not disappointed at all. So soft and cushioned. Blocks out all noise when mowing the yard or at the gym. They don't slip out of my ear. Great purchase, if you are on the fence - go for it.
The sales feature for me was additional pads for smaller ears.

I will be contacting the seller in regards to these concerns, though the Bluetooth connection to my phone is poor and seems to only want to have stable connection when i have my phone in my hands or bra. I don't feel these go as loudly as they should, when being used for exercise.

Best Headphones (BT and regular) I've owned. Sound quality and pairing is great. Stability is great. Sound isolation is pretty good. It works well with my iPhone. On the negative side, it is a little snug for my big head and my ears get a bit warm but what should I expect.
Bought these for my 6 year old daughter and she loves them!
Amazing sound quality, soft fit, best sounding headphones (under 20 bucks) we bought for our kids. Two year factory warranty sealed the deal
Music quality is great

These work great on my iPhone but do not connect to my laptop. I tried everything and they won’t work on my laptop at all. They connected in seconds to my iPhone though. The sound quality is crisp and clear. The battery life has been great and I’m overall happy with my purchase.
Despite these being for small ears, these are still too big. I tried the smallest ear piece and they don’t fit. They just fall right back out. I’ve got to find smaller ones.
Bought for my wife and she loves it. Has had it on her key chain for months and the rubber still holds up. Definitely worth it

I took these on vacation and every single S sounded like static, nothing but mids and high end out of these. The frequency response is terrible! They feel and look cheap but I didn't expect such terrible audio quality.

These AeroBuds have known battery problems. And of course AeroBuds doesnt stand by their product, they want almost has much as new headphones to replace the battery. First one failed within the first year, the repalcement failed within 6months, and AeroBuds just says yeah it happens....great headphones when they work, but expesnive for a product that doesnt last.

Bought these for my son, the sound is good but the plastic used for the headband cracked after 1st use (when spreading to place over his ears), he liked the sound so returned for a replacement, is just more careful with them now and has not had any issues.
I have bought this headphone brand new around year ago, I have used it only several times, headset was sitting mostly in its own case, because of uncomfortably.
Brought it as a gift. Very nice
Loved these earbbuds. Perfect sound, bass my only but is they did fall sometimes. So I had to watch them closely

Bought this because of a positive review comparing sound, price, and quality. Very impressed. Never really owned any high end headphones before, but these sound great to me with excellent clarity and neutral sound. Plus, it supports both wired and Bluetooth connections. The fit pretty solid on my ears which filters outside noise.
Good for the price. No complaint.
They are a decent set but the issue we had is that they came blue instead of yellow as they are depicted/described.
I bought these to use as a headset for talking on skype, gotomeeting, etc. People say the sound of my voice is poor.
Son love it-loves that it goes and can always find it.
Fits the case well and the silicon is soft but the "hinge" portion is flimsy and the cover for the charge point was tough to open.
The quality and style is what I needed to protect my AeroBuds. Fits perfect and the texture is good so it doesn't slip out of my hands.
Radio literally broke 3 days after using it. Do not buy this product.
Came in vacuum packed wrapping, but seems to work as intended.

Very good-sounding headphones! These are perhaps the most underrated headphones in the market. Not many people have heard of them, but they sound really really good. This coming from an audiophile with revered headphones like the AeroBuds HD800, AeroBuds V6 and 7506, HD598, AT M50, AT M70, etc.

I wasn't sure that they would fit as my ear canals are smaller but the fit was good and they had a nice selection of ear pieces. When talking on the phone the voice is clear and noise cancellation works good. the touch control works well and volume is easily adjusted. For the price they are a good deal and I would buy they again.
My husband got these for himself and the work great.
Great smartwatch for the money. It does everything the listing stays it will do, and it is very easy to use. Download the app and do easy set up. Great smartwatch!
Watch was fine, at first. The watch is now 7th months old, and is no longer working. Even inexpensive watches, should last for at least a year.

Battery life is very good, accurate for heart rate and Oxygen levels and able to receive messages and calls. Also able to answer calls. I especially like the monitoring of my cycling for heart rate etc. I am happy with purchase.

I bought this mainly to track my exercise, however it is very easy to accidentally pause or turn off the tracking when in exercise mode, with movements of the wrist. This means it actually isn't tracking activity, when you think it is. I really don't have the opportunity to constantly check my watch while exercising.

These are my second replacements, they do not even fit in ear snugly, sound quality poor, doesn't cancel out background noise even if sound through turned off. Very disappointed, you need monster shrek ears for these to even fit. Took over a month to get the replacements back. You know they a refurbished, I paid for new not refurbished. Hitting up social media to crush this company's hype. Sincerely, Professional stunt Actor and Public figure.

Is not what they show In The picture. I was very disappointed and sent it back. Wouldn’t read the SIM card ( kept saying to please insert it.). The holes to the wrist weren’t punched out. The camera was very cheap and bad quality. Since all the other watches seemed to be around the same price I thought that that’s just the price of these watches. I would not recommend these at all

I will take this watch over a fit bit any day! In fact my husband bought me a fit bit and I returned it because thus watch is soooo much better. What I like most is the BATTERY LIFE IS AMAZING! I bought it weeks ago and have only charged it twice.

The watch is for my 6 yo niece and the set up took a long time because it freezes and does not respond to the touch screen. the lag with the touch screen commands were frustrating and it takes a 3-4 seconds to move onto the app, or opening anything. I know this is no PulseFit but the delay in responsiveness made this tough for a child to use.
It has all the tracking functions I need, and is easy to use. Highly recommended!
Some of the functions I don't have the need to use, but those that I do use perform perfectly. The extra watch band was a plus. Well worth the price.

The watch looks beautiful, but there are some issues. The seller sent us a U.K. model and the wall plug is this huge UK plug with an adapter. The battery life is crap as it did not last a full day on normal usage. The watch did not automatically update the operating system and unless you were aware you would be using the outdated software. I would not recommend unless you want to lug the charger with you wherever you go.

This is my third Gamin watch I normally can get at least 3 years out of the watch and yest i use it twice a day 5-6 times a week. So i do get my money's worth from this watch. I don't have to use the manual to get this watch going so that's a big plus. Great Watch AR
Watch is nice, the buckle broke off the band after a few days, but we were able to get a replacement for about $8. it was hard to change because there were no instructions, but we got it.
My daughter loves it. Works great and easy to use

It didn't have any manual or anything written enclosed to help a novice like me get it charged up and working. I'm waiting for my son to arrive for setup help. It looks like new with no scratches, no blemishes or other indications of wear.
Yardage were accurate but it was very difficult to read the screen .
The watch itself is good but the manual doesn't explain real clear what to do .
Nice watch not with good battery life and small screen. Returned it because it has small screen and it's wristband is terrible.

dismal battery life, yet small which is good for sleeping, however, not worth it to me. Got the Galaxy 5 instead. The LTE DID work with PulseFit Fi. Best wait for Gen2. They did not refund the money until the 28th, choosing instead to print the words: we will refund it when we receive it. Indicates it was stolen to me, if UPS gave me a receipt, then they should update that.
